text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall from Period 1 to Period 10 despite several declines, reinforcing that I should judge progress over longer horizons, not month by month.","I made no trades, which avoided impulsive decisions, but inaction alone does not ensure my portfolio remains diversified or appropriate for my needs.","Before trading, I should review my holdings, risk tolerance, and longer-term plan rather than infer a trend from a few monthly returns."]}
